children: ICICI Securities research report on Supreme Industries

We recently met the management of Supreme Industries (SI). Takeaways: 1) Demand momentum in pipes is healthy in Q2FY27-TD, as the PVC price trend is favourable, resulting in restocking by channel partners. 2) Margin trajectory remains steady and the company expects to achieve its OPM guidance of 14-14.5% in FY27. 3) SI believes agriculture demand, which got deferred in Q1FY27 due to high volatility in PVC prices, should see a pick-up from end-Sep’26. 4) Management has maintained its pipe volume guidance of ~15-17% for FY27. We believe, going forward, pipe demand could be healthy as PVC prices now have a floor post the imposition of minimum import price (MIP), which is likely to result in normalised channel offtake.
Maintain BUY with a rolled-over Sep’27E SoTP-based TP of INR 4,035.
